item.title: Foteini Savvidou
item.description: Foteini Savvidou is an undergraduate student in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki (AUTH), Greece, affiliated with the Telecommunications Laboratory. She is interested in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Wireless Communications, Internet of Things (IoT), and Cloud Technologies, as well as in applications of technology in healthcare and education. In addition to her academic activities, she is actively involved in tech communities and constantly shares her knowledge and experience in AI, IoT, and Azure technologies.
